summary: Going from one client's app to the next in the harness console flashed the phone layout for a few frames before the desktop one. A view that was not on show was `display: none`, so it had no size and the app inside had laid itself out for no room; shown, it measured its real width and laid out again in sight. AppStage now keeps a hidden view in the layout at full size, invisible and inert, so it is already the right shape when its turn comes.
